sc-county-council.summary: Every South Carolina county is run by an elected county council, and this app does not yet show you which council district you live in or who represents it.
sc-county-council.why: The council districts and the election results that name the members are both published, and this app has not built them into a layer yet. Until it does, the County card names the county and nobody on its council.
sc-county-council.wanted: Nothing from a reader — this one is ours to build.

sc-municipal-officeholders.summary: This app can tell you which South Carolina city or town you are in, and not who your mayor or council members are.
sc-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of South Carolina's mayors and council members has been read yet. The boundary this card draws carries geography and no officeholder at all, and this app never guesses a name.
sc-municipal-officeholders.wanted: A statewide roster of mayors and council members, or each city's own published list.

sc-school-board-members.summary: This app names your school district and not the people who run it.
sc-school-board-members.why: South Carolina's school boards are not all chosen the same way, and no statewide list of their members has been read yet. The boundary this card draws carries the district's name and nothing about its board.
sc-school-board-members.wanted: A statewide roster of school board members, or each district's own published list of its board.

sc-tribal-government.summary: No card names the Catawba Nation or its government for a point on its land near Rock Hill, the only tribal land the Census records in South Carolina.
sc-tribal-government.why: Tribal governments are being added across the whole app at once rather than state by state, and that work has not reached South Carolina yet.
sc-tribal-government.wanted: Nothing from a reader yet. The nation's own published list of its government is the source this will read.
